code.name: Coal mining as migrant livelihood
code.definition: Passages where immigrants or their family members describe mine work as the way they earned a living after arrival.

code.name: Health costs of physical labor
code.definition: Passages describing how years of physical work — in mines, factories, or smokehouses — damaged workers' bodies and forced them to stop working.

code.name: Long-tenure packing house employment
code.definition: Passages describing decades-long employment in a single industrial workplace such as a meatpacking plant.

code.name: Barter and farm surplus as economy
code.definition: Passages where households describe trading home-produced goods such as milk, eggs, cattle, or clothing for other necessities rather than using cash.

code.name: Men migrating ahead to work
code.definition: Passages where husbands or fathers travel to a destination alone first to find work, with the family joining later.

code.name: Loss of possessions in transit
code.definition: Passages describing theft, loss, or damage of belongings during the journey between home country and destination.

code.name: Depression-era work scarcity
code.definition: Passages where workers describe intermittent employment, low wages, or hardship during the 1930s economic downturn.

code.name: Bureaucratic cost of departure
code.definition: Passages describing the many offices, approvals, or trips required to obtain permission to emigrate.

code.name: Class fare downgraded on passage
code.definition: Passages where paying for a higher travel class is disregarded and passengers are placed in a lower class aboard the ship.

code.name: Chain settlement by home region
code.definition: Passages describing how immigrants from the same village or region cluster in the same American towns and rely on one another for adjustment.

code.name: Domestic labor as only work after arrival
code.definition: Passages describing how, after migration, a woman's productive farm work in the home country is reduced to housework, laundry, and cooking in the new country.
